messages:
elaine: quick heads-up — i'm putting together a short CLI playbook for tenant onboarding. goal: a super-slim checklist + a couple of CLI/snippet examples that call out weird tenant-labels, regional failover, and legacy scale-policy gotchas.

mike: love it. can you call out the edge-case where tenant labels mismatch the org name? we've seen customers lose autoscale because of that.

elaine: yes. planning to add a step: `rwdctl tenant validate-labels --tenant-id <id>` and a note about label normalization.

raul: also flag that older terraform modules used `scale_policy: legacy` which doesn't map to the new autoscale schema. customers tried to migrate and got silent rejections. suggest a migration snippet.

elaine: good point. draft migration snippet:
```
# terraform migration hint (pseudo)
resource "rwd_dedicated_pool" "m" {
  tenant_id = var.tenant_id
  autoscale {
    policy = "balanced" # replace legacy values: legacy -> balanced/throughput
  }
}
```

jen: tiny nit — show the CLI dry-run output example. people copy/paste and freak out when quotas change.

elaine: adding dry-run example and explicit rollback command. sample CLI block:
```
# show plan for provisioning a tenant-reserved pool (dry-run)
rwdctl reserved create --tenant-id T-123 --gpu a100-80gb --region us-west-2 --dry-run
# real run
rwdctl reserved create --tenant-id T-123 --gpu a100-80gb --region us-west-2 --commit
```

mike: can we include a small troubleshooting checklist for pre-provision failures? e.g., cert issues with private deployments, quota exceeded errors, and KMS permission denial. one-liners ok.

elaine: yup — planning a 4-step triage: 1) validate org/tenant labels, 2) check region quotas (`aws service-quotas`), 3) verify KMS key policy, 4) inspect provisioner logs (`rwdctl logs provisioner --tenant-id`).

raul: for the docs PR, please add explicit callouts about SLA impact when isolation decorators are used. those decorators can move tenants to reserved pools and change their latency SLOs. customers need clarity.

elaine: will add a short paragraph: "Isolation decorators may route traffic to reserved capacity; confirm SLA changes with your CSM before enabling in prod."

jen: also add a tiny SDK snippet for Node/Python showing how to select a dedicated model variant at request time — it's a common ask.

elaine: draft SDK snippet (node):
```js
// select dedicated model for low-latency route
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RWD_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-dedicated/gpt-2-dedicated-v1',
  input: 'hello',
  routing: { tier: 'dedicated' }
});
```

mike: okay. one last thing — link-fix: the current handbook link to the quota matrix goes to an internal google sheet. we should point to the public quota page or embed a snapshot.

elaine: noted. i'll replace the sheet link with `/docs/dedicated/quota-matrix` and add a footnote about private-sheet access.

deploy-bot: PR created by elaine: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/docs/+/1234 :eyes:

jen: i'll skim the PR after lunch. if we can keep the playbook under one page and include those three snippets (cli, terraform, node) we're good. :+1:

elaine: thanks — i'll iterate on the PR with your feedback and ping here when ready for final review.

mike: appreciated. small asks only — call out any breaking changes in a highlighted note.

elaine: will do. planning to merge after addl review and quick lint pass.

deploy-bot: PR 1234 merged by elaine  — docs site build queued.
